question: In a certain code language, 'HUSBAND' is written as 'JVUDBPF' and 'SISTER' is written as ‘UJUVFT'. How will 'BROTHER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HUSBAND' is written as 'JVUDBPF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97961cadbfa5598edb479974ece8020ef462ed8bf0cb85bad9be53e174f7ab40.png] 

And,

'SISTER' is written as ‘UJUVFT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/363e74146a15c0e28c22e10a0ccab8c7d600e08cee6785281a8d9cd7e52652fd.png] 

Similarly,

'BROTHER' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a276d17cbabc09c221764a4103d870289d9f189331e277b0c5d7627cfd13e5e.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
